# API Contracts

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Conventions

- Base: `/api/v1`, route names `api.v1.*` (`routes/api.php`). No OpenAPI/GraphQL schema in repo.
- Auth: Sanctum stateful cookie (`$middleware->statefulApi()` in `bootstrap/app.php`); SPA must send `Referer`/`Origin` from a stateful domain.
- Middleware on all non-login routes: `auth:sanctum` + `active` (`EnsureUserIsActive`). Ownership: Policies → `403` for foreign records.
- JSON errors for `api/*` (`shouldRenderJsonWhen`). Validation → `422` `{message, errors}`.
- Throttle → `429` `{"message": ..., "retry_after": N}` + `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-*` (`bootstrap/app.php`). Global `api` limiter 120/min.
- Resources (`app/Http/Resources/*`) wrap payloads in `data`; lookups as slugs; timestamps ISO 8601.

### HTTP endpoints

| Family | Method | Path | Throttle | Success | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Auth | POST | `/auth/login` (public) | `login` 5/min | 200 `UserResource` | 422, 403 deactivated, 429 |
| Auth | POST | `/auth/logout` | — | 204 | 401 |
| Auth | GET | `/auth/me` | — | 200 `UserResource` | 401 |
| AI | GET | `/ai/models` | — | 200 `AiModelResource[]` | 401 |
| Agents | GET | `/agents` | — | 200 `AgentSummaryResource[]` | 401 |
| Agents | GET | `/agent-executions` | — | 200 `AgentExecutionResource[]` | 401 |
| Activity | GET | `/activity?from&to&type=agent\|tool\|approval&page` | — | 200 `ActivityResource[]` | 422 |
| Preferences | GET / PUT | `/preferences` | — | 200 `UserPreferenceResource` | 422 |
| Conversations | GET | `/conversations` | — | 200 `ConversationResource[]` | — |
| Conversations | POST | `/conversations` | — | 201 (title `Nova conversa`) | — |
| Conversations | GET | `/conversations/{id}` | — | 200 + `messages` (50/page) + `next_cursor` | 403 |
| Conversations | PATCH | `/conversations/{id}` (`title` 1–120) | — | 200 | 403, 422 |
| Conversations | DELETE | `/conversations/{id}` | — | 200 `{"data":{"deleted":true}}` | 403 |
| Messages | POST | `/conversations/{id}/messages` | `messages` (setting, default 60/min) | 202 | 402 cost cap, 403, 422, 429 |
| Memories | GET | `/memories?status&q` | — | 200 paginated (20) + `summary` | — |
| Memories | POST | `/memories` | — | 201 | 422 |
| Memories | PATCH / DELETE | `/memories/{id}` | — | 200 / 200 `deleted` | 403 |
| Memories | POST | `/memories/{id}/confirm` · `/discard` | — | 200 | 403 |
| Approvals | GET | `/approvals`, `/approvals/{id}` | — | 200 `ApprovalResource` | 403 |
| Approvals | POST | `/approvals/{id}/approve` · `/deny` (`reason` ≤500) | `approvals` 30/min | 200 | 403 not owner, 409 decided/expired, 422 |
| Tasks | GET | `/tasks`, `/tasks/{id}` | — | 200 `TaskResource` | 403 |
| Tasks | POST | `/tasks/{id}/cancel` | — | 200 | 409 not cancellable |
| Tasks | POST | `/tasks/{id}/retry` | — | 201 new task | 409 not failed |
| Connectors | GET / POST | `/connectors` | — | 200 / 201 `ConnectorResource` | 422 bad URL |
| Connectors | PATCH / DELETE | `/connectors/{id}` | — | 200 | 403 global connector |
| Connectors | POST | `/connectors/{id}/resync` | `connectors.resync` 6/min per connector | 202 `{"data":{"queued":true}}` | 403, 429 |
| Connector tools | GET / PATCH | `/connectors/{id}/tools[/{tool}]` | — | 200 `ConnectorToolResource` | 403, 404 foreign tool, 422 unavailable |
| Notifications | GET | `/notifications` | — | 200 `NotificationResource[]` | — |
| Notifications | POST | `/notifications/read-all` · `/{id}/read` | — | 200 | 403 |

Non-API HTTP: `GET /up` (`HealthController`, DB/Redis/Reverb), `GET /manifest.webmanifest` (`PwaManifestController`), `GET /` + fallback → SPA shell (`routes/web.php`), `/broadcasting/auth` (middleware `web, auth:sanctum, active`), `/admin` (Filament, `admin` gate).

### Message formats

Broadcast (Reverb, `ShouldBroadcastNow`, no queue) on private channel `user.{id}` (owner only, `routes/channels.php`). SPA listens with dot-prefixed names (`resources/js/composables/use*Events.ts`).

| Event (`broadcastAs`) | Class | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `assistant.state.changed` | `Events\Assistant\AssistantStateChanged` | `{state, conversation_id}`; state ∈ `IDLE, LISTENING, THINKING, SPEAKING, EXECUTING, SLEEPING, ERROR, DISCONNECTED` |
| `assistant.thinking` | `AssistantThinking` | message id |
| `assistant.response.chunk` | `AssistantResponseChunk` | `{message_id, delta, index, conversation_id}` |
| `assistant.response.completed` | `AssistantResponseCompleted` | final message |
| `conversation.message.created` | `ConversationMessageCreated` | message |
| `conversation.title.changed` | `ConversationTitleChanged` | `{conversation: {id, title}}` |
| `agent.started` · `agent.progress` · `agent.completed` · `agent.failed` | `Events\Agent\*` | agent execution |
| `tool.started` · `tool.completed` · `tool.failed` | `Events\Tool\*` | tool execution |
| `task.updated` | `Events\Task\TaskUpdated` | `{task: TaskResource}` (progress throttled 500 ms) |
| `approval` decision | `Events\Approval\ApprovalDecided` | consumed by listeners `ExecuteApprovedTool`, `PublishDeniedApproval` |
| `connector.status.changed` | `Events\Connector\StatusChanged` | connector + previous status |
| notification | `Events\NotificationCreated` | notification |

Chunk example — `tests/Feature/AssistantEventsTest.php`:

```json
{ "message_id": 42, "delta": "Olá", "index": 0, "conversation_id": 7 }
```

Queues (Redis, worker `queue:work redis --queue=tasks,default,low --tries=3 --timeout=960`):

| Job | Queue | `$tries` | `$timeout` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ProcessUserMessage` | `default` | 1 | 120 s |
| `GenerateConversationTitle` | `default` | 1 | 120 s |
| `SyncMcpServerTools` | `default` | 1 | 120 s |
| `ExtractMemoryHypotheses` | `low` | 1 | 120 s |
| `RunTask` | `tasks` (`RunTask::QUEUE`) | 1 | task `timeout_seconds` (default 900) |

- Job-level `$tries = 1` overrides worker `--tries=3`: AI calls never retried.
- No DLQ; failures go to `failed_jobs` (driver `database-uuids`, `config/queue.php`). `RunTask::failed()` marks task `failed` + `task_failed` notification.
- Structured result payloads (`messages.payload`, `tasks.result`) follow `resources/schemas/results/{text,list,table,report,search_results,task_card,data,execution_status,document}.json`.
